request: Help a team plan and track its work: create, assign, and update tasks in its projects. Also shape the operations, so that each tool is easy for a model to call correctly.
summary:
`config.yaml` now passes `--dry-run`. It exposes 12 Asana tools for planning and tracking work. I ran only the dry run, so none of the tools have been called against Asana.

- **Tools:** `get_workspaces`, `get_projects_for_workspace`, `get_sections_for_project` and `get_users_for_workspace` find the right IDs. `get_tasks_for_project` and `get_task` read tasks. `create_task`, `create_subtask_for_task`, `update_task`, `add_task_for_section`, `add_project_for_task` and `create_story_for_task` (comments) change them. I left out the rest of the large spec, so it can't touch goals, portfolios, webhooks or admin settings. You can widen the list later with `policy.allow`.
- **Shaping:**
  - `create_task` and `update_task` take flat inputs (name, notes, assignee, due_on, start_on, projects, parent, completed). Asana wraps the body in `data`, and the config does that wrapping itself. Both return just the task's id, name and link.
  - `get_task` and `get_tasks_for_project` default to a short set of useful fields instead of Asana's bare IDs.
  - The `instructions` text tells the model to look up workspace, project and user IDs before it assigns anything.
- **Auth:** Asana's spec supports a personal access token, so I set bearer auth with `${ASANA_TOKEN}`. Set that environment variable to a token from Asana's developer console.
- **Base URL:** `base_url` is still the placeholder `https://upstream.invalid`, as you asked. Before running for real, change it to `https://app.asana.com/api/1.0`.
- **Not covered:** `update_task` can't clear an assignee or a date, because there is no way to send a null.

To run it: `uvx openapi-mcp-gateway --config config.yaml`
